doc.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Closing remarks and upcoming Zinno's dates
summary: Congratulations on his marriage, scheduling his week at Zinno's, and thanks and goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been a real treat again. You look great. Congratulations on your recent marriage. And I’m glad things are going well for you.
They’re going very well, yeah. I have no complaints.
And let me know when you’re going to be at Zinno’s.
Okay. I’m going to be there the first week in March.
Oh. Well, Tim, we’ll have to come back down.

They do a Wednesday through Saturday week now. On Monday and Tuesday, or Sunday, Monday and Tuesday, which are slow nights, they have like entertainment, but the main heavy jazz is like Wednesday through Saturday. So the first week in March we’ll be there with the quartet.
So if you’re in town, please come by and be my guest.
Thanks again for bringing the recordings.
And I’ll send you the new “Harlem Lullaby.”
Please. I’ll guard it with my life.
All right, Monk, it’s been a pleasure. Thank you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
